features.statement: Navigation is placed inline on the same light header row as the logo, with the menu toggle styled as a transparent button.
Content sits in a centered fixed-width container with generous side margins instead of running near full width.
Page is a single column of stacked full-width sections with no sidebar.
Page background alternates between white, light grey and dark near-black bands, with an explicit white body background.
Palette is neutral near-black with white and off-white text, avoiding tinted blue-grey, and uses a crimson red accent.
Typography uses a system-ui font stack rather than a custom webfont.
Section and footer headings are set in all caps.
Product captions are bold, title-case and left-aligned inside the card rather than small uppercase centered labels.
Cards use moderately rounded corners, with bordered white rounded cards and dark rounded tiles.
Text-only cards carry a bold red left border accent, creating an uneven grid of image and text cards.
Calls to action are compact, centered rounded buttons, rather than full-width bars or sidebar cards.
Newsletter signup is a centered horizontal inline form row.
Promotional blocks are flat full-width dark or grey bands with plain text, rather than photo backgrounds or image ads.
Layout uses CSS grid for some content and has a clean slider with non-overlapping slides.
Markup is lean, with few divs, scripts, classes and inline styles, and no external stylesheets.
Semantic structure uses nav and section elements, and post titles are h3 headings with populated outline.
Promotional banners include a descriptive subline beneath the main heading, and warranty offers appear as text links.
Product thumbnails have empty alt text while hero images carry descriptive alts.
Footer includes a back-to-top link and lists offers as plain links, without payment icon graphics.
